evidence: You're dead... and you ain't taking me with you!

sex.rationale: Very little sexual content in the subtitles — mostly mild flirtation/terms of endearment and excitement ('You're so sweet', 'Gives me a rush', 'Come on, baby'). No explicit sexual acts or nudity.

evidence: Because if you say another word, I'll fucking kill you.
